summary.text: Eloise Gómez Reyes was elected to represent California's 29th Senate District in 2024. She was born and raised in the Inland Empire.

paragraphs.text: Before the Senate she served eight years in the California State Assembly, becoming Majority Leader in 2020.

Her official biography says she was the first Latina to open her own law firm in the Inland Empire. She graduated from San Bernardino Valley College, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Southern California and a law degree from Loyola Law School.
